cause_claim: Change w-x3c9/change/0291 adds rule-0291 specifying 2 criteria (f02, f21) for template T7. Template-registry declares field_count=21 (ic-0034); rule-validator validates against field_count=21 (ic-0035). However content-interpreter expects inputs_supplied=20 (ic-0036). All candidate experiments (x-76d751baea804df6, x-978f4330054c4556, x-934cb71d35db492c, x-4c020aa2aeb044ff) consistently show exit_code=3 with fatal error: rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (20 inputs supplied); interpreter stopped. The rule-validator passes (0 rejected) because 2 criteria are within field_count=21, but the interpreter cannot process the rule as its criteria structure does not match the 20 inputs_supplied contract. The exact rule structure that would satisfy the interpreter was not tested within budget.
